hero.title: Together, we help rebuild lives in Ukraine
hero.subtitle: Humanitarian support, education, and recovery for Ukraine.

1stProject.title: Emergency Aid
1stProject.description: Distribution of food and non-food items, including medicines, in conflict-affected communities in Kherson and Mykolaiv.

2ndProject.title: Social Taxi Service
2ndProject.description: Emergency transport for people with disabilities and the elderly in Kherson and Mykolaiv. In areas where public transport is disrupted or unsafe, the Social Taxi serves as a reliable support for those already living under constant threat and danger in communities near the frontline.

3rdProject.title: From Children of Kyiv to Children of Kherson
3rdProject.description: Through this initiative I HELP delivers educational kits to support children’s learning in conflict-affected areas of Kherson. This effort is driven by a network of nurseries and early education schools where school communities actively collect, prepare and deliver the supplies, strengthening community ownership and ensuring that assistance reaches learners who need it most.

4thProject.title: Veteran Family Space
4thProject.description: In collaboration with Return to Peaceful Life, this initiative fosters reintegration of veterans and their families into community life, supporting social connection, psychological resilience, and long-term recovery.

impact.title: Our Impact
impact.description: Since 2022, our routes have reached some of the most dangerous regions - including Bakhmut, Soledar, Izium, and Kherson. We work where support is desperately needed, despite risk and hardship.
impact.communityHelp: communities of Kherson/Mykolaiv regions have established stable contacts
impact.childrenHelp: children supported with education and psychological care

watchNow.title: Featured Story
watchNow.caption: Every journey matters - watch how Social Taxi connects people to safety.

joinUs.title: Join the iHELP Mission - Together We Can Change Lives
joinUs.description: Thanks to your support, we’ve reached thousands of families in liberated areas of Kyiv, Kherson, and Donetsk regions - and other war-affected zones. We meet urgent needs, but also help people believe in a better future.

photoOfChanges.title: Voices of Change
photoOfChanges.subtitle: We believe small acts create big change. Together, we’re helping build the future.
photoOfChanges.firstPhoto: In every child's smile is a victory over war. That is why supporting families with children is so important.
photoOfChanges.secondPhoto: We were the first to arrive in Stanislav, a newly liberated village in the Kherson region. We brought not only aid, but also, most importantly, the feeling that people were remembered.
photoOfChanges.thirdPhoto: Treats, books, toys - anything to relieve the tension of war and bring smiles back to children.
photoOfChanges.fourthPhoto: We are providing the people of Donetsk region with blankets and household items so that comfort can return to their homes.
photoOfChanges.fifthPhoto: We help children of the Kherson region learn, dream, and feel that childhood continues.
photoOfChanges.sixthPhoto: Even during the war, the women of the Kherson region continue to give light and beauty to the world. We are here to support them with care, attention, and quality cosmetics.

media.title: In the Media
media.subtitle: We’re proud to share our results - and the media is talking about us. Transparency and trust are the foundation of everything we do.
